BasisRankRecommendedAdaptive.meaning: rank of the recommended placement among the basis by adaptive-rule mean AUROC

BasisRankRecommendedMatched.meaning: rank of the recommended placement among the basis by matched-rule mean AUROC

BasisRankPublishedAdaptive.meaning: rank of the published placement among the basis by adaptive-rule mean AUROC

BasisBestPlacement.meaning: the basis placement with the highest adaptive-rule mean AUROC

BasisBestAurocAdaptive.meaning: the highest adaptive-rule mean AUROC in the basis

BasisMeasuredSize.meaning: basis placements whose rate ladder reaches the adaptive target on the panel

BasisUnmeasuredSize.meaning: basis placements the panel declares but never reaches at the adaptive target

BasisWorstPlacement.meaning: the basis placement with the lowest adaptive-rule mean AUROC

BasisWorstAurocAdaptive.meaning: the lowest adaptive-rule mean AUROC in the basis

PublishedInversions.meaning: cells below chance for the published placement at the adaptive rule

PublishedFloorAuroc.meaning: worst single cell of the published placement at the adaptive rule

RecommendedReachMatched.meaning: cells the recommended placement reaches at the matched rule

BasisSpreadAdaptive.meaning: adaptive-rule mean AUROC spread between the best and worst basis placement

PositionRangeTokenMaskMatched.meaning: range of mean AUROC across the all-blocks token_mask positions, matched rule

OperatorRangeAttentionNormMatched.meaning: range of mean AUROC across the operators at before_attention_norm, matched rule

OperatorRangeAttentionNormMasksMatched.meaning: range of mean AUROC across the 2 masking operators at before_attention_norm, matched rule

PositionOverOperatorRatioMatched.meaning: position range over operator range at matched rule, gaussian included

PositionOverOperatorRatioMasksMatched.meaning: position range over operator range at matched rule, masking operators only

PositionRangeTokenMaskAdaptive.meaning: range of mean AUROC across the all-blocks token_mask positions, adaptive rule

OperatorRangeAttentionNormAdaptive.meaning: range of mean AUROC across the operators at before_attention_norm, adaptive rule

OperatorRangeAttentionNormMasksAdaptive.meaning: range of mean AUROC across the 2 masking operators at before_attention_norm, adaptive rule

PositionOverOperatorRatioAdaptive.meaning: position range over operator range at adaptive rule, gaussian included

PositionOverOperatorRatioMasksAdaptive.meaning: position range over operator range at adaptive rule, masking operators only
